Failure se failure tak ka safar, bina josh khoe.
Aksar yeh namumkin lagta hai, jab tak ho na jaye.
Hell se guzar rahe ho, chalte raho.
Rasta khud dikhao.
"Challenges life ko interesting banate—unko overcome karke meaningful."
Disappointment success ki tuition hai.
Chalte raho; mushkil badhe toh growth bhi badhe.
Organized raho.
Lohha garam hone ka intezaar mat karo; usse maar kar hi garam karo.
Zindagi ya toh adventure hai, ya kuch nahi.
